title: Chocolate Resourcepack
description: Adds tasty chocolate bars to Minecraft!
body: This resourcepack adds a new sweet to Minecraft: The chocolate. It adds the texture, model and languages for the best chocolate experience. Our Chocolate bar even has some secrets, so check it out! It is Server friendly and Vanilla like and fits perfectly in every Minecraft world! [Required datapack (click)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/chocolate-datapack)
